body.heading: Where in the world is Bangladesh?
paragraphs: Bangladesh is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Bangladesh is Dhaka.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Bangladesh is Bangla.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Bangladesh is the Bangladeshi taka.

body.heading: How big is Bangladesh?
paragraphs: Bangladesh covers about 148,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Oman.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest on Earth, a watery maze of rivers and mudflats where Bengal tigers swim between the trees.
Cox's Bazar claims one of the longest unbroken sandy beaches in the world — around 120 kilometres of golden sand along the Bay of Bengal.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Bangladesh on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Bangladesh in one breath: a country in Southern Asia, capital Dhaka, where people speak Bangla and pay with the Bangladeshi taka.
